transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1846 Gretna Green Drive?
Yes, this is 1846 Gretna Green Drive. I’m safe and alone, no water inside, and I can’t leave on my own — but I don’t need help right now.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety status. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There’s one person here, and I’m the only one — no one else is at the house.

I heard you're alone at the house. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No, I’m alone and no one here can’t leave on their own. I didn’t say I’m alone — I meant no one here is unable to leave.
Understood, no one here is unable to leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?

No, there’s no water inside the home right now.  
*(corrects themselves)*  
Actually, there is no water inside — I meant to say, no water inside.
Got it, no water inside the home right now. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No water inside, and I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to give rides.
Understood, no truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — just one person here, no water inside yet. I’m safe and can’t leave alone, but I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to help.
I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
